plugin.name: Splinter Cell Essentials PPSSPP Fusion Fix
SkipIntro.description: Skip the loader’s first movie; its required second movie remains intact. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
StickDeadzone.description: Set the deadzone for both analog sticks. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
SpeedStickControl.description: Use the left stick to control movement speed. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
FPSLimit.description: Use native elapsed-time simulation with the main-loop 60 FPS limiter. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
UnthrottleEmuDuringLoading.description: Unthrottle during loading. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
FOVFactor.description: Scale gameplay FOV; device close-ups keep their native overlay framing.
HudScale.description: Scale the HUD at its screen edge or HUD box edge.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places the HUD at the screen edges: light and sound meters, weapon and quick inventory on the right, objective and training boxes on the left, transmissions at the top left. A ratio keeps them in a centered box (4:3 to 32:9). Menus, loading screens and movies stay centered at the game's own shape.
ForceAspectRatio.description: Auto follows PPSSPP's display aspect. Enter W:H or a decimal (1:1 to 4:1) to override it.
